workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Face Tilt

authority_chain.kernel_route: TopoShape.replaceShape / BRepTools_ReShape -> sew/fix shell normalization -> makeSolid when required

bounded_scope: unique +Z top planar face is re-resolved geometrically on every authoritative revision without persistent FaceN storage
selected top face is tilted about its own center Y axis by bounded signed angles +5 deg and -5 deg
selected top face plus four adjacent planar side faces are replaced through TopoShape.replaceShape / BRepTools_ReShape
opposite bottom face is not replaced
ReShape intermediate is normalized only from ReShape-emitted faces using sew/fix shell normalization and makeSolid when required
edited result is not rebuilt from source box dimensions
R001 80x50x10 mm and R002 100x50x10 mm both produce valid single-solid B-Rep results
R001 positive and negative results are symmetric at bbox height 13.486229709906326 mm and volume 39923.89396183491 mm3
R002 positive and negative results are symmetric at bbox height 14.357787137382909 mm and volume 49904.86745229365 mm3
actual top-face normals resolve to signed +5/-5 degrees within numerical tolerance
30 degree excessive tilt is rejected before geometry mutation by the bounded angular failure gate
FCStd plus positive and negative STEP artifacts persist valid authority and signed angle metadata
Blender receives only the positive R002 tessellated derivative and remains display-only after save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Material changes to selector semantics, face replacement cardinality, tilt axis, allowed angular envelope, ReShape normalization path, FreeCAD/OCCT version, Blender version or display-authority readback require a new receipt.
authority_note: This receipt proves one bounded planar top-face center-Y tilt route only. It does not establish arbitrary face rotation, persistent topological naming or P0-B PASS.
